title: Live feed, gateway to client, v1
description: Every message the gateway sends on the WebSocket /ws/v1. The type field says which one it is.

oneOf.title: hello
oneOf.description: Sent once, right after the connection opens.

heartbeatSeconds.description: A heartbeat follows at least this often. A client that sees none for a few intervals should treat the connection as broken.

oneOf.title: subscribed
oneOf.description: Answer to a subscribe message: the subscription now in force.

oneOf.title: aircraft
oneOf.description: A new state of an aircraft inside the subscribed area. state is an adsb.state.v1 message.

oneOf.title: telemetry
oneOf.description: A new reading of a sensor. reading is a telemetry.v1 message.

oneOf.title: sensor-status
oneOf.description: A sensor changed status. event is a sensor.status.v1 message. Sent to clients that subscribed to sensors.

oneOf.title: heartbeat
oneOf.description: Sent at a fixed interval whether or not there is data, so a quiet feed can be told from a broken connection.

oneOf.title: error
oneOf.description: A message from the client could not be used. The subscription in force is unchanged.
